# quarto-dev/homebrew-tap

Homebrew formulae for Quarto tools.

## Quarto 2 (`q2`)

```sh
brew install quarto-dev/tap/q2
brew upgrade q2
```

Works on macOS and Linux (arm64 and x86_64). The formula installs the
prebuilt release binaries.

## Do not edit formulae here

`Formula/q2.rb` is generated by `scripts/homebrew-formula.sh` in
[quarto-dev/q2](https://github.com/quarto-dev/q2) and pushed by that repo's
release pipeline for each stable release. Edits made here are overwritten
by the next release. Report problems and propose changes in quarto-dev/q2.
